title: Tensor pullback maps onto the extended ideal
statement: For a scheme morphism g:X→Y and an ideal sheaf J on Y, there is a unique module morphism g*(J)→J O_X whose composite with the inclusion is the pulled-back inclusion followed by the canonical structure-module comparison. It is epi, and it is an isomorphism when g is flat. The module pullback and ideal-sheaf notions are those of [def-pc-module-pullback, def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf].

proof.text: Apply the ideal-product pullback image theorem to the unit module and transport the image along the structure-module isomorphism. Its image is exactly the extended ideal.

Factor through the image. This factor is epi, and the monic ideal inclusion makes it unique. Under flat pullback the original inclusion remains mono, hence the factor is both mono and epi and therefore an isomorphism.

theorem existsUnique_idealTensorPullbackComparison {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (J : Y.IdealSheafData) :
    ∃! d : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).obj J.toModules ⟶ (J.comap g).toModules,
      d ≫ (J.comap g).toModulesι =
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).map J.toModulesι ≫
          Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit g ∧
      Epi d ∧ (Flat g → IsIso d)
